tool.name: qiime2 sidle prepare-extracted-region
tool.description: Prepares an already extracted region to be a kmer database.
tool.command: export XDG_CONFIG_HOME="\$PWD/xdgconfig" MPLCONFIGDIR="\$PWD/mplconfigdir" NUMBA_CACHE_DIR="\$PWD/numbacache" CONDA_PREFIX=/opt/conda/envs/sidle-0.1.0-beta && q2galaxy run sidle prepare_extracted_region '$inputs'

param.name: sequences
param.label: Reference sequences
param.help: [required] The full length sequences from the reference database.

param.name: region
param.label: Region identifier
param.help: [required] A unique description of the hypervariable region being extracted.
param.validator: value is not None and len(value) > 0

param.name: trim_length
param.label: Regional sequence length
param.help: [required] The length of the extracted regional kmers.

param.name: fwd_primer
param.label: Forward primer
param.help: [required] The forward primer used to amplify the region of interest.
param.validator: value is not None and len(value) > 0

param.name: rev_primer
param.label: Reverse primer
param.help: [required] The reverse primer used to amplify the region of interest.
param.validator: value is not None and len(value) > 0

param.name: reverse_complement_rev
param.label: Reverse complement rev
param.help: [default: Yes] If the reverse primer was reverse complemented during sequence extraction. This is used to later generate fragments for the phylogenetic tree.

param.name: reverse_complement_result
param.label: Reverse complement result
param.help: [default: No] Whether the sequences for alignment should be reverse complemented for alignment, for example, in cases where the forward and reverse primers do not overlap and you want to align with the reverse sequence.

param.name: chunk_size
param.label: Sequences per processing block
param.help: [default: 10000] The number of sequences to be analyzed in parallel blocks.

param.name: debug
param.label: Run without a parallel client
param.help: [default: No] Whether the function should be run in debug mode (without a client) or not. `debug` superceeds all options.

param.name: n_workers
param.label: Parallel workers
param.help: [default: 1] The number of jobs to initiate.

tool.help:
QIIME 2: sidle prepare-extracted-region ======================================= Prepares an already extracted region to be a kmer database.
Outputs: -------- :collapsed_kmers.qza: Reference kmer sequences for the region with the degenerate sequences expanded and duplicated sequences identified. :kmer_map.qza: A mapping relationship between the name of the sequence in the database and the kmer identifier used in this region.
|
Description: ------------ This function takes an amplified region of the database, expands the degenerate sequences and collapses the duplicated sequences under a single id that can be untangled later.
|
